items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 我是七七，是个僵尸…啊，还要说什么来着。
items.text_en: I am Qiqi. I am a zombie. And I... forgot what comes next.

items.title: 闲聊·自言自语
items.text: 咦，刚刚…我想说什么来着…
items.text_en: Hey, do you know what? Uhh... neither do I. I... already forgot.

items.title: 闲聊·怕热
items.text_en: Let's go somewhere cooler.

items.title: 闲聊·锻炼
items.text: 七二三四，七二三四…五六七七，五六七七…
items.text_en: One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four...

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text_en: I forgot my umbrella again.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I want to build a snowman. Will you help?

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text_en: I should have stayed indoors today.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text_en: The wind is... frigid. I like it.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 拉手…拉手！要、要被吹跑了！…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Hold my hand please. This wind could blow me away.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早上了吗？今天要做的是…我看看笔记。
items.text_en: Morning means it's time to check my diary. Because my diary reminds me what I'm supposed to do in the morning.

items.title: 中午好
items.text_en: I just remembered something. I forgot to help Dr. Baizhu prepare medications.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 晚上好。今天…我做了什么来着…
items.text_en: Good evening. How was your day? My day was... fine, I think. But I can't remember.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你先休息吧，我该去做柔软体操了…不要偷看。
items.text_en: It's time for you to sleep now. I will do my stretches. ...Do not watch me, please.

items.title: 关于七七自己
items.text: 你问我吗…？对不起，我不记得了…
items.text_en: Did you ask me something? Sorry... I forgot.

items.title: 关于我们·记忆力
items.text: 很多事情我都记不起来了，但是…也没什么不好。
items.text_en: I have a poor memory for most things. But as far as I know, that doesn't matter.

items.title: 关于我们·记忆力锻炼
items.text: 最近我努力做了很多记忆力锻炼，所以不用担心我会忘记你了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I started memory training exercises recently. So don't worry, I won't forget who you are.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」，虽然无法停住时间，但是给了我守护重要之人的力量。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My Vision can't turn back time. But at least it gives me the power to protect the people that matter most.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 其实我的身体状况比白先生好很多…
items.text_en: I may be a corpse, but I am in a much better physical condition than Dr. Baizhu.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 药庐附近有时候会有小团雀出没，小小的一团。
items.text_en: Sometimes I see finches near the pharmacy. A nice little group of finches.

items.title: 关于白术
items.text: 我记不起来白先生的脸了，但是也没什么关系…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I can never remember Dr. Baizhu's face. But I don't mind.

items.title: 关于胡桃
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Warm. Fake smile. Death. I despise Hu Tao.

items.title: 关于魈·名字
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sounds like a historical artifact to me.

items.title: 关于魈·记忆
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Remind me, have I met him before?

items.title: 关于辛焱
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4...Who?

items.title: 关于瑶瑶
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Cute. Like a nice little finch.

items.title: 关于小冥
items.text: 晚上…偶尔会感觉到有人和我一起做体操…是错觉吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4On some nights, I almost feel like someone is doing stretches together with me. But maybe I just have an overactive imagination.

items.title: 想要了解七七·其一
items.text_en: What's going on?

items.title: 想要了解七七·其二
items.text: 柔软体操，让我能够保持和人类一样的身体状态。但是如果放松下来的话，就会变回去…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I perform stretches regularly to help me maintain the same range of movement as a normal human being. But as soon as I stop doing them, the rigor mortis starts to set in again.

items.title: 想要了解七七·其三
items.text: 有的人想要利用我，有的人很害怕我。但是你…和他们都不一样。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Some people want to take advantage of me. Others are terrified of me. But you... You are not like any of those people.

items.title: 想要了解七七·其四
items.text: 从第一次见面开始，你就给我一种很温暖的感觉。和让人不舒服的热不一样，是我的心，感觉到了温暖。谢谢你…我很高兴。可惜我只认识现在的你，如果以后我忘记了…我们就…不，我会「命令」自己记住你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Since we first met, I have had a warm feeling inside. Not the kind of warmth that makes me feel rotten and disgusting and closer to death. The other kind of warm. The one that happens inside my heart. Thank you. I am happy. Sadly I only recognize the current you. If I forget you... No. I will order myself to remember you.

items.title: 想要了解七七·其五
items.text: 以前我只想要活下去，虽然不知道为了什么活下去…但现在我好像知道了，以后想要和你一起活下去。我、我们可以…永远一直在一起吗？啊…真的可以吗？嗯！我会保护好你的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6In the past, my only thought was: I must stay alive. Even though I didn't know what to live for. But now, I think I know. I want to live with you. I want to ask, can we always stay together, for the rest of life, until death? Yes or no? Yes? Is that your real answer? Good, excellent. I promise to always protect you.

items.title: 七七的爱好
items.text: 想要一只小宠物…小团雀那样子的。
items.text_en: I want to have a pet. For example, a nice little finch.

items.title: 七七的烦恼
items.text: 我不明白，但是，温度高会让身体很难受…
items.text_en: I don't know why, but high temperatures make me feel... disgusting.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 喜欢椰奶。但是…尝不出味道。
items.text_en: I like coconut milk... But, I don't know what it tastes like.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text_en: Sorry, I have no idea.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生辰快乐。给，草药香囊。很惊讶吗？上次你告诉我的时候，我就记在纸上了。每天都看一遍的话，今后也不会忘记的…
items.text_en: Many happy returns. Here is a bag of herbal medicine for you. You must be very surprised that I remembered? Let me explain. Last time you told me, I wrote your birthday down on a piece of paper. If I look at something once a day, it eventually goes into my long-term memory, and it will stay there forever.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 啊，变强了吗…变强，是什么呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Now, I have more power. But... what does that mean? Please explain. Thank you.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 啊，理解了。变强之后，控制力量需要更多的精力了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2Ah, I understand. When I get stronger, I need to put more effort into controlling my strength.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 以前我对更加强大并没有概念，但是现在…我希望能够再强一点。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4In the past, I did not understand the idea of being stronger than I already was. Now that I understand it well, I wish I was just a little stronger still.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 这一切都是因为你在，谢谢你…可以答应我一个愿望吗？今后…就让我来保护你吧，好不好？
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6All of this is because of you. Thank you very much. Can you make me a promise? From now on, please, let me protect you. Do you accept? Yes or no?

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text_en: Wheel of life.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text_en: Life goes on.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text_en: Go.

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text_en: Rise.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text_en: Orders given. Orders received.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text_en: Sacred name: Fortune Preserver.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text_en: Opening box of Adepti tricks.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text_en: Faster? Okay, faster.

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text_en: Uh... Huh...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text_en: Ooh, pretty.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text_en: Treasure chests... hmm... do we like treasure chests?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text_en: Wasn't there something in here a second ago...?

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text_en: Ow.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text_en: Oh no...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text_en: I must live on...

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text_en: Don't want... to be sealed... back up...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text_en: Cold... So cold...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text_en: No...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text_en: I didn't feel that.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text_en: Wow.

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text_en: Oh...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text_en: I'm here.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text_en: What's happening?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text_en: I will... bring my notebook.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 凉凉的，很喜欢。虽然没有味道...
items.text_en: Cold. I like it. But, no flavor...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text_en: Huh...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text_en: It's burning my tongue...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text_en: Danger.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text_en: Stop. Let me do it.
